evidence_boundary: Final bounded run waited for one /cmd_vel subscriber and kept nonzero command duration <=0.3s. It proves bridge startup, /battery, /imu/data, /trashbot/stop, and restored API fresh T=1001 ACK. It does not prove bounded-run /odom or dynamic /tf nonzero, and does not prove T=1001.L/R nonzero during motion because the current bridge does not expose L/R and raw UART retry produced corrupted/incomplete lines.

t1001_lr_motion_window.reason: No valid raw T=1001 line with nonzero L/R was captured during the bounded bridge motion window.

attempt_notes: Initial attempt failed because ROS setup was sourced under set -u (AMENT_TRACE_SETUP_FILES unbound).

A ROS CLI long-pulse retry produced nonzero /odom and /tf but the /cmd_vel CLI latency made the nonzero command window about 3s, so it is archived only as diagnostic context, not the bounded safety evidence.
A direct raw UART retry produced corrupted/incomplete T=1001 lines and did not prove nonzero L/R.
Final bounded discovery-wait run kept nonzero_duration_s <= 0.3 but /odom and /tf stayed at zero.
